summary: M6 review (Opus subagent, 715-line diff): 0 Critical, 5 Important, 7 Minor; no second round. Fixed: review_diff fetches main first (lib/review.sh), the prompt asks for the counts, reviewFindings strict, found_nothing reads every entry, later attempts after a round stay on opus, the round's diff line names opus. 1 Minor left (#8). Tests 492 → 501.
verified_how: Red then green: `review_diff: fetches main first, so a milestone merged meanwhile drops out; the run directory is left out`, `review_diff: fails with the reason when origin has no such main branch` (I1); `review gate: a review's prompt asks for <n> Critical, <n> Important, <n> Minor in its entry summary; a build session's doesn't` (I2); `reviewFindings: reads Critical before Important in either order of word and count, never a step number or lowercase prose` (I3); `reviewSummary: a review counts as finding nothing only when every entry that gives counts reports 0 Critical, 0 Important` (I4); `review gate: after an escalation round that doesn't pass, the review's next attempt runs on opus and never escalates again` (I5/M6), `review gate: the escalation round's Review diff line names the model it runs on` (M7). Coverage (I5), green on arrival: `…no counts is noted not escalated…`, `…refused by a usage limit runs again on opus, still at no attempt`. Simplifications: kind computed once (driver), review_diff stderr dropped, stub R sonnet. bash -n on driver.sh, config.sh, review.sh, stub-claude.sh, checks 41 and 42; node --check summary.mjs, entries.mjs. Full suite via check.sh: green, 501 tests.

dead_ends.why: 500/501: `harness memlint: a project … prints the same two findings` failed once under load; alone 19/19, the rerun green 501/501. Code M6 never touched

discoveries.text: tests/checks/39's `harness memlint: a project (or a directory in it) prints the same two findings…` failed once in a full TEST_JOBS=4 run and passed alone and on the rerun: a load flake (likely the run's memlint note vs the direct call)
review_diff now lives in lib/review.sh (sourced by the driver) and fetches MAIN_BRANCH first; a check can source it in a throwaway repo

A review's prompt now has a second {{REVIEW_DIFF}} line `Review findings: give your entry's summary this review's findings as `<n> Critical, <n> Important, <n> Minor``; reviewFindings reads only capitalised Critical/Important

questions: The M6 review left Minor #8: the `passes=true` note and commit come before the gate un-passes a review for its round, and summary.json's cause doesn't say a round is pending. Worth a fix, or is the following `one round on opus` note enough?
